slices.focus: Heavy rain soaks the back room of Ariana's shotgun house, forcing a storage overhaul
slices.summary: After another heavy rain makes the back room smell swampy, Devon insists on clearing it out. Ariana and Devon buy shelving risers, switch to sealed bins, and get the landlord to patch the rear wall. Ariana creates a rain checklist to monitor the room.
open_loops: Creating a rain checklist taped inside the closet door
Taking inventory of what remains in the back room
Maintaining a buffer zone along the patched wall
